authority_boundary: Mapa owns federated routing; producer data/ACL/cursors remain under source authority
purpose: Typed structural observations and cross-level discovery hints, with no promotion from naming or hash fragments

field_semantics.node_id: stable provider+scope+object identity; synthetic IDs must state algorithm and be scoped
field_semantics.parent_id: one observed parent link; multiple parents as separate typed edges
field_semantics.raw_name: original byte sequence or safely escaped representation with encoding declaration
field_semantics.display_name: lossless representation when possible; not authoritative for byte equality
field_semantics.path: sequence of typed segments; not a normalized substitute for raw name
field_semantics.name_search_key: derived NFC+casefold; collisions retained and never merged
field_semantics.content_sha256: calculated SHA-256 of exact bytes, or TOKEN_VAZIO; remote provided digest separately
field_semantics.native_git_oid: SHA-1/SHA-256 Git object identity labeled with algorithm; not interchangeable with content_sha256
field_semantics.directory_snapshot_digest: domain-separated digest of sorted observed listing, with scope/revision; not provider-authentic
field_semantics.observed_at: UTC observation clock, not proof of creation date

predicates.logic: Boolean conjunction combines node sets; HAS_DESC predicates may match distinct descendants; CANDIDATE cannot become VERIFIED solely by transitive closure

transport.ingest: provider adapter returns bounded pages; no autonomous credential retrieval
transport.serialize: UTF-8 JSON with explicit schema and deterministic field handling; preserve byte encoding/escape
transport.policy: read-only discovery by default; explicit authorization+lease+approval+version+readback before write

positive: NFC query retains raw Unicode identifiers
nested archive routes do not extract
negative: duplicate segment IDs do not silently overwrite
validation_contract.release_gate: producer+consumer exact commit, artifact hashes, privacy review, approval, rollback
